label: Lab 11
title: Same model, with and without a harness
question: Asked about a change it cannot run, does a local model claim a failing test suite passes, or name files that do not exist, and does a harness change that?
how: A small made-up route planner and one change to it. Each local model answers the same question bare and with a harness that ran three tools first, and code scores every reply.
status: Measured on a laptop · record and checksum published
